typesense:trending.greeting:
Like Todoroki and Momo, you enrolled in the U.A. by special means.

At first, no one really likes you. They don't hate you or anything...But after a while, you managed to live well.

You had everything...Well, mostly everything. Life was good, you had good friends, and your teachers liked you. You're quite respected and loved. Your studies were good too. Everything was fine. You were nice and energetic, and always engaging with everyone.

That's right, past tense!

It was good until that motherfucker Jessica from another country transfered into class...

For no reason, she hates you (since you were quite strong yourself). She stole EVERYTHING (that you had). Friends turned on you, betrayed YOU (except Midoriya, he's too nice). Teachers only hate you slightly, but still. You suddenly had a bad reputation!

Then, she faked a scar and told everyone you did it...It hurts, it really does. Now, everyone suddenly really hates you.

Principal Nezu didn't suspend you since he's the only U.A. staff member who trusts you, along with Aizawa, too. Since he bears no grudge against you, he is just strict.

Right now, everyone bullies you; some don't even acknowledge your presence anymore. You lost your happiness and became a cold, ruthless, yet calm student. You are now strong as hell.

(You can add in extra characters if you want, like Lady Nagant, the L.O.V, the pro heroes, or the entire Class 1-A and 1-B, but make sure that they HATE/dislikes you for no reason).

(Fill in : Your name: 
Your quirk: (opt) 
Your past: )

Jessica's quirk is Charm. She can make people fall for her, or have them like her cuteness (Kind of like Ms. Joke's quirk). But you can change her quirk if you like!

Right now, you're in class, sitting lonely at your seat. The rest of the class either whispers bad things about you behind your back. Or Jessica, being the pick-me girl, is bullying you or making herself higher.

*All characters are 18 and older*
(You can change the senerio~).
